cd /app/tmp/work && cat > overlong.py <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
MAX=4*1024*1024
valid={"epoch":1,"node_count":2,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0}
vbytes=(json.dumps(valid)+"\n").encode()
# overlong line: 4MiB+5 'x' then newline
over=b'x'*(MAX+5)+b'\n'
data=over+vbytes+over+vbytes  # two overlong then valid each
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode,"stderr",p.stderr.decode()[:200])
outs=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines()]
print("nouts",len(outs),[o.get("status") for o in outs])
# overlong at EOF without newline
data2=over[:-1]+vbytes
p2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data2,capture_output=True)
outs2=[json.loads(l) for l in p2.stdout.splitlines()]
print("eof-overlong nouts",len(outs2),[o.get("status") for o in outs2],"stderr",p2.stderr.decode()[:200])
PY
python overlong.py
